visual_action: Rep. Katie Porter stands in front of a white board and speaks to the camera. She then turns and writes "iwillvote.com" on the board with a black marker, before turning back to the camera and gesturing towards the website she wrote.

cast.name: Katie Porter
cast.evidence: She is the only person in the video, is identified by face-ID, and introduces herself by name: "Hi, I'm Congresswoman Katie Porter".

spoken_summary: Rep. Katie Porter delivers a message encouraging viewers to visit the website iwillvote.com to make a plan to vote on or before Election Day.
audio_music: The video features only spoken dialogue with no background music or sound effects.
editing_pacing: The video consists of a single, continuous, static shot with no cuts.
central_claim: Voters should visit the website iwillvote.com to make a plan for voting in the upcoming election.
intended_effect: To encourage viewers to visit the website and prepare to vote.
